ultramarine.$description: Ultramarine — Feature card backgrounds, brand-emphasis headlines, footer primary CTA — vivid violet-blue carries the entire brand voice, used as punctuation against the monochromatic cream field

gold.$description: Gold — Primary action buttons (Request a demo), accent cards — warm yellow against neutral surfaces creates the only chromatic urgency in an otherwise achromatic system

forest.$description: Forest — Decorative illustration and testimonial card accents — deep dark green used in editorial color blocks

tangerine.$description: Tangerine — Decorative scribble accents and highlight strokes in illustrations

royal.$description: Royal — Soft highlight washes and secondary illustration fills — lighter companion to ultramarine

sky.$description: Sky — Pastel card surfaces and muted testimonial accents — near-gray blue used as a quiet cool counterpoint to the warm beige field

thistle.$description: Thistle — Pastel illustration fills and testimonial card tints — near-gray mauve

mint.$description: Mint — Decorative green accent for illustration highlights

cream.$description: Cream — Page background, card surfaces, input fills — warm off-white dominates the entire canvas

pearl.$description: Pearl — Elevated card surfaces, lighter than cream — used for nested content blocks

white.$description: White — Pure white cards and inverted button text

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted helper text and secondary labels

concrete.$description: Concrete — Hairline borders, subtle dividers, disabled states

washed-black.$description: Washed Black — Primary text, headings, body copy — slightly softer than pure black for warmer reading

ink.$description: Ink — Secondary text and nav items

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Muted body text, captions, metadata

dim.$description: Dim — Tertiary text, timestamps, fine print

black.$description: Black — Button text on bright fills, strong borders

abcwhyte.$description: UI micro-copy — nav labels, tag chips, small captions, footer links
